api_contract.selected_set: selected_set(G_float32,h_float32,lower,upper,row_labels=...) -> VALID/INVALID input plus SELECTED_FEASIBLE, SELECTED_INFEASIBLE or UNKNOWN; selected safety AND active alpha rows must be supplied.
api_contract.decomposition: diagnose_current({F:{G,h,row_labels},U:{G,h,row_labels}},lower26,upper26); F columns 0..13, U columns 14..25. K=K_F x K_U only for frozen independent command blocks and their already-allocated h. A feasible product is not a certificate for unsplit physical constraints.
api_contract.queue: queue_local_risk(J_float32,d_float32,dmin_float32,q26,pending6x26); no queue changes. Returns LOCAL_LINEAR_UNSAFE or LOCAL_ENDPOINTS_NONNEGATIVE and always future_physical_safety UNKNOWN. No timing inferred from FIFO indices.

state_meanings.VALID: Well-formed finite exact input snapshot for the declared algebraic question, not physically safe.
state_meanings.SELECTED_FEASIBLE: Explicit rationally checked current-set witness exists.
state_meanings.SELECTED_INFEASIBLE: Exact box contradiction or rational separating certificate excludes every current boxed command; not a physical collision assertion.
state_meanings.UNKNOWN: Malformed/nonfinite/missing coverage, failed numerical solve, unverified certificate, or missing future dynamics. Never coerced to SAFE.
state_meanings.OBSERVED_UNSAFE: Only supplied current geometric d<dmin is strictly negative.
state_meanings.LOCAL_LINEAR_UNSAFE: A frozen-J target endpoint has strictly negative rational margin. Conditional mathematical risk only.

api_contract.minimum_preissue_recommendation: At the selected-call seam capture actual float32 G/h, row IDs/masks, alpha rows, all 26 box endpoints, measured q/qd, issued target, exact six pending targets and state/queue identity. Report current-set status, returned-command residual and conflict support. Queue probes add heuristic flags; they do not authorize a recovery action or overwrite FIFO.
api_contract.strict_endpoint: No geometry epsilon. Equality is nonnegative; one negative float32 ULP and the smallest negative float32 RHS are tested. Rational checks interpret finite float32 coefficients exactly. HiGHS 1e-9 tolerance only proposes candidates; it never changes h/box/endpoints.
api_contract.minimal_certificate: For y>=0, a=y^T G, b=y^T h, L=sum_j a_j*(lower_j if a_j>=0 else upper_j). If exact L-b>0 then current set empty. If an exact witness x satisfies all original rows/box then current set nonempty. Otherwise UNKNOWN.
api_contract.per_row_limit: min_box G_i x<=h_i for every row is necessary, not sufficient; 2 opposing rows can be individually feasible with empty intersection.
api_contract.f_u_safety_limit: Post-authority allocated rows certify only themselves, not raw h_before_authority, excluded rows, all9021 geometry, or physical motion.

proved_counterexamples.name: command_vmax_not_measured_qd_bound
proved_counterexamples.example: dt=.02, vmax=1.5, u=0 obeys |u|<=.03. Linear double integrator qdot=v, vdot=0 with v=2 obeys the command constraint while measured speed exceeds vmax. Without a plant relation/bound on v, the implication cannot be derived. All other 25 coordinates may vary independently.
proved_counterexamples.proof_status: analytic explicit toy dynamics, not SafeDuo dynamics

proved_counterexamples.name: zero_hull_not_feasibility
proved_counterexamples.example: Original B=[-1,1], reference R=[.25,.5], hull(R,0)=[0,.5], row x<=-.25. Original B intersects the row; hull contains zero but its intersection is empty. The 26D randomized positive-orthant version fails even for the componentwise hull, which contains the true convex hull.

proved_counterexamples.name: current_feasible_not_queue_future_feasible
proved_counterexamples.example: Linear margin m(q)=.5+q, q=0, command u in [-.1,.1], current row -u<=.5 is feasible. Six irrevocable targets -1 and explicit toy plant q_next=pending[0] give q_next=-1, m=-.5 and next row -u<=-.5, infeasible in the same box. A new command cannot alter the oldest pending target.
proved_counterexamples.proof_status: conditional exact linear example, not a plant estimate

proved_counterexamples.name: row_authority_not_joint_feasibility
proved_counterexamples.example: u in [-1,1], u<=-.25 and -u<=-.25. Each halfspace intersects the box; summing gives 0<=-.5.

proved_counterexamples.name: benign_endpoint_does_not_supply_missing_model
proved_counterexamples.example: The same current J/q/six targets permit different future acceleration/servo responses when dynamics are unbounded. Nonnegative frozen endpoint probes supply no bound on the actual path; output must remain UNKNOWN.
proved_counterexamples.proof_status: scope/identifiability negative controls, not measured physical failures
